title: RTP: Have shim header dissector return 0 on error
description:
The RTP shim header dissector returns the number of bytes consumed
to dissect the RTP header. However when an unknown version number
is encountered the current offset is returned. That should be the
number of bytes consumed, i.e. 0.
Fix the user of this function to handle this situation properly.


(cherry-picked from commit 3071100e63d517e5df4810ebec943a1d3f4661a9)

Co-authored-by: Jaap Keuter <jaap.keuter@xs4all.nl>
